tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included. It is not disabled for local testing or convenience. This sits alongside the recorded decision to enforce https everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. Its single paragraph says TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included. It also notes that this sits alongside the decision to enforce https everywhere with no plaintext exception for any service.

I took this from the project's recorded decisions, #31 and #34. I didn't open the full records. The catalog entries and the session excerpt were enough. I left out the earlier plan to disable verification in dev builds, since it was retired.

My first attempt, a shell command, failed with a parser error. I wrote the file with the file-write tool instead, and it succeeded.
